intro.note: Solve each pair. Show your working and answers in your workbook.
methodSteps: 1  Make y the subject of the straight line
5  Find each pair (x, y) and check
commonMistakes: There are usually two answers, not one — find both x values, e.g. x = 3 and x = −1.
Get everything on one side so it = 0 first, e.g. x² = 2x + 3 becomes x² − 2x − 3 = 0.
Watch minus signs: (x − 1)² = x² − 2x + 1, not x² − 1.
Each x has its own y — put x back in to find y.
workedExample: Solve:  y = x² − 2x + 3  and  y = x + 3

questions.content: x² + y² = 9   and   y = x + 1   (give answers in surd form)
A rectangle has area 12 cm² and perimeter 14 cm. Form and solve a pair of equations to find its length (x) and width (y).
